The full-source pushforward also has the proved maps from every
declared mixed support \(\lambda=(W,S;\mathfrak a)\).
Its coefficient copies retain the independent outer label and
the coefficient mask, including an empty mask at a present label.
For one original leg the exact map is
\[
 \eta_W:V/W\longrightarrow\mathscr B_\Omega/\Theta W,
 \qquad [v]\longmapsto[\Theta v]_W .
\]
Injectivity follows from injectivity of \(\Theta\).  Its image
is the kernel of the map to \(\mathscr B_\Omega/\Theta V\):
a representative maps to zero precisely when it is \(\Theta v\).
These maps applied to each admitted coefficient copy give the
full kernel \((V/W)^{\mathfrak a}\), without altering the outer
label.  The full coefficient masks, action intertwiners and
zero-coordinate insertion maps are proved in (MCF42)--(MCF51)
and (D9)--(D14).

For tensor sources retain the declared subcomplex
\(\mathsf C_\lambda^\bullet\subseteq\mathsf C_{\rm full}^\bullet\).
The exact comparison on top quotient classes has kernel
\[
 \frac{d\mathsf C_{\rm full}^{k-1}\cap\mathsf C_\lambda^k}
      {d\mathsf C_\lambda^{k-1}}.
\]
The isomorphism sends a represented boundary to its original
class; its inverse chooses the same representative.  Both are
well-defined because their equivalence relation is the
displayed denominator.  The ordered polynomial divisions and
signed original tensor primitive in (ISM38)--(ISM43) compute
the actual member \([d\widetilde K_v]_\lambda\) of this kernel
for each canonical metric secant whose compared top
representatives lie in \(\mathsf C_\lambda^k\).
It vanishes at this label exactly when
\(d\widetilde K_v\in d\mathsf C_\lambda^{k-1}\).

The original finite source tower also retains its actual type:
\(D\) sends \(W_m^{\rm src}\) to \(W_{m+1}^{\rm src}\),
giving the quotient arrow and residual of (R1b)--(R1c).
The source-level preimages of the arithmetic length-two
quotient in (MCF47)--(MCF51), together with the shifted
filtrations proved in MW and MRE, carry those adjacent-level
arrows.  Their low-degree one-leg tail is acyclic at the
full source \(W=V\); the proper-source tail retains
\(H^1=V/W\), and the two-leg complex retains its
degree-zero diagonal kernel.  Thus the
original tau pushforward and its arithmetic quotient are
connected through the actual source kernel and filtered
preimages throughout this edition.

The newly supplied canonical-projector formula has the exact
operator correspondence
\[
 \Pi_N=R_NG_N^{-1}R_N^*M_{2q}=P_N-Q_N,\qquad
 \mathcal A=\Pi_{q-1}+\Pi_q-\Pi_{2q-1}-\Pi_{2q}=U-W .
\]
Here every \(R_N\) is padded by the original coefficient
inclusion into the same \(\mathcal P_{2q}\).  The decomposition
\(\mathcal P_N=R_NE\perp_M\chi\mathcal P_{N-q}\) proves the
first equality: subtracting \(R_N\pi_\chi p\) from \(p\)
gives an original relation, and canonical orthogonality
annihilates its cross Gram.  The restricted remainder map
is the inverse of \(R_N:E\to\operatorname{ran}\Pi_N\).
Thus the signed trace in this result is precisely the
supplied trace, with \(\operatorname{Tr}\mathcal A=0\).

For two source forms \(M_0,M_1\), let
\(\Delta=R_1-R_0=B_N(Z_0-Z_1)\), where
\(Z_i=(B_N^*M_iB_N)^{-1}B_N^*M_iC_{\rm rem}\).
The complete original remainder lift is \(C_{\rm rem}\).
Orthogonality expands both secants with their actual signs:
\[
 \begin{split}
 G_1-aG_0&=R_1^*(M_1-aM_0)R_1+a\Delta^*M_0\Delta,\\
 bG_0-G_1&=R_0^*(bM_0-M_1)R_0+\Delta^*M_1\Delta.
 \end{split}
\]
At the first endpoint the relation space is zero and
\(\Delta=0\).  Equations (ISM4)--(ISM12) prove these
identities and their full source enclosure; the revised
coefficient \(2q-1\) and all smaller common-source controls
are retained at that same proof site.

For admitted degrees \(i\leq j\), the canonical reverse
restriction \(T_{ij}=G_i^{-1}G_j\)
has the exact cross trace
\(\operatorname{Tr}(\Pi_i\Pi_j)=\operatorname{Tr}T_{ij}\).
Indeed \(R_j^*MR_i=G_j\), by the original relation-valued
section difference, and substitution in the trace proves
the identity.  The full proof (ISM21)--(ISM26) retains the
cross term between the two projector differences in
\(\operatorname{Tr}(\mathcal A^2)\).  Centering \(C\) by
its actual trace mean gives
\[
 |\mathcal B'|\leq
 \sqrt{\left(\operatorname{Tr}(C^2)
        -\frac{(\operatorname{Tr}C)^2}{2q+1}\right)
                      \operatorname{Tr}(\mathcal A^2)} .
\]
Weighted self-adjointness and Hilbert--Schmidt
Cauchy--Schwarz prove this on the original metric.
Furthermore (ISM28)--(ISM37) constructs a finite
matrix polynomial \(C^{[L]}\), with exact residual,
whose signed integral \(j_L\) encloses the correction:
\[
 j_L-e_L\leq\mathcal B(1)-\mathcal B(0)\leq j_L+e_L,
 \qquad
 e_L\leq\vartheta^{L+1}\sqrt{K_D(8q-6)}\longrightarrow0.
\]
All of \(C^{[L]},j_L,e_L,\vartheta,K_D\) are explicitly
defined and proved in (RMT19)--(RMT21), with their
identity to the ISM notation.  This supplies a constructed
residual on the actual finite source, preserving the
signed center and all arithmetic entries.

The complete full-spectrum, trace-norm, overlap, centered
Hilbert--Schmidt and angle controls now apply jointly to
this same integrand.  With their full definitions
(RMT8)--(RMT13), the current stronger bound at this site is
\[
 |\mathcal B(1)-\mathcal B(0)|
 \leq J_q=\int_0^1\min\{E_q,T_q,O_q,S_q,A_q\}\,dx
 \leq\mathcal L_q(D)\leq(2q-1)\log\kappa .
\]
Here \(T_q=d_x\|U_x-W_x\|_1/2\) retains the exact trace
norm, \(O_q\) its two proved overlap majorants, and
\(S_q\) the supplied centered variance bound.  Their
complete proofs and the exact source correspondence are
in (RMT3)--(RMT15).  Every entry bounds the identical
signed trace, so taking its pointwise minimum and
integrating proves the displayed inequality.
The angle entry \(A_q\) uses the actual common moment
path and its proved positivity in R74; for a general
positive coefficient form the other four entries and
the finite signed certificate retain their proved scope.

key: R74 signed interval carried through nonlinear coordinate

In the preceding formula the refined radius is the actual
\(I_q\) of (RMT13), with \(a=m=2q-1\); it divides each
of the five same-source pointwise controls by the exact
derivative denominator of the nonlinear coordinate.
Differentiating
\(\mathscr H_m(B)=2\operatorname{arcosh}(e^{B/(2m)})\)
gives \(1/(m\sqrt{1-e^{-B/m}})\), so that integration
proves this replacement of the former radius
\(\log\kappa\).  Its inverse is
\(2m\log\cosh(z/2)\), with continuous value zero at zero.
Write \(B_0=\mathcal B(0)\), \(H_0=\mathscr H_m(B_0)\).
For every constructed finite order \(L\), the resulting
current interval is
\[
 \begin{split}
 \mathcal B(1)&\geq
 \max\left\{0,B_0-J_q,
   2m\log\cosh\left(\frac{\max\{0,H_0-I_q\}}2\right),
   B_0+j_L-e_L\right\},\\
 \mathcal B(1)&\leq
 \min\left\{B_0+J_q,
   2m\log\cosh\left(\frac{H_0+I_q}2\right),
   B_0+j_L+e_L\right\}.
 \end{split}
\]
Each entry is a bound proved in R72--R73 or obtained
by applying the increasing inverse just calculated;
their intersection therefore contains the same actual
endpoint.  The complete proof (RMT19)--(RMT22) retains
the computed geometric residual and original theta
comparison; it also proves the scalar and \(q=1\)
cases without dropping any coefficient or source mass.
The same new upper endpoint is substituted into the
central arithmetic and inverse-return estimates at
R44--R45 and R47 and their complete earlier proofs.
